# 1 Enoch Chapter 50 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**50:1** In those days, everything will change for the holy and the chosen. The light of eternity will rest on them, and glory and honor will be given to the holy.

**50:2** On the day of reckoning, all the evil stored up against sinners will come due. The righteous will triumph in the name of the Lord of Spirits. And God will let the others watch this — so that they might repent and turn away from everything they have done.

**50:3** They will not deserve honor through the name of the Lord of Spirits — yet through his name they can still be saved. The Lord of Spirits will show them compassion, for his compassion is vast.

**50:4** He is just in all his judgments, and in his glorious presence unrighteousness cannot stand. At his judgment, the unrepentant will perish before him.

**50:5** "After that, I will show them no mercy," declares the Lord of Spirits.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 50 offers a rare window of grace within the judgment scenario: sinners witness the vindication of the righteous and may still repent (v. 2). This is not universalism, but it is remarkable universalist tendency within an apocalyptic framework. The door closes permanently in v. 5 with the divine declaration.*
